source.discoveryMethod: Clicked the 3091 marker and followed Daten der Verkehrsmessstelle / Herunterladen in the official GIS info panel.

findings.finding: Station 3091 and route 337 identified, with a location map and annual-average hourly traffic split toward Pfäffikon and Saland. No detector arrows or loop/channel layout shown.
Annual DTV 7336; legend identifies R1 as Fahrtrichtung Pfäffikon and R2 as Fahrtrichtung Saland. These are report labels, not verified feed detector/channel assignments.
Traffic profiles, annual patterns, events area and holiday calendar. No surveyed detector bearing or station plan found.

missingEvidence: Dated, georeferenced sensor/loop layout at station 3091, including north arrow and travel-direction arrows.
Mapping from installed channel/loop identifiers to feed detector ZH.CH:3091.02, or equivalent independent evidence.
Confirmation of applicability to the 8 September 2026 recording date.

limitation: Public annual-report discovery corrects the earlier unsuccessful guessed URL. It does not resolve the 1401.93 m Saland direct-distance failure, change any original scope or audit, or admit playback. No conclusion is drawn about whether station plans exist in the authenticated portals.
